stories.title: Rinzel’s OT goal lifts Blackhawks over Flames 4-3
stories.summary: Sam Rinzel scored the overtime winner and had two assists to lead the Chicago Blackhawks past the Calgary Flames 4-3 on Saturday, snapping a nine-game road winless skid.

stories.title: Elks continue Grey Cup celebration with parade
stories.summary: The Edmonton Elks capped off a week of celebrating their Grey Cup win by leading a holiday parade on Saturday.

stories.title: Calgary man pleads guilty to threatening to kill Prime Minister Mark Carney and family
stories.summary: Jamie Dacosta yawned and laughed as his videos threatening to slit the prime minister's throat and harm his family were played in the Calgary courtroom.

stories.title: Tenants ordered to vacate ‘state-of-chaos’ apartment building in central Edmonton
stories.summary: Stadium Plaza tenants were released from their leases at the 'state-of-chaos apartment building' that's become overrun by squatters and has no heat due to copper pipe theft.

stories.title: Calgary mayor believes revisions coming to bike lane bill, province mum on who pays
stories.summary: Calgary's mayor said Premier Danielle Smith's office promised him municipalities won't have to pay for bike lane removal and the bill put forward is a 'premature draft version.'

stories.title: Alberta tweaks carbon capture incentive program to allow grants during construction
stories.summary: The change to cover 12 per cent of eligible capital costs is meant to better align provincial policy with the federal Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage Tax Credit.

stories.title: Rancher says Alberta well cleanup fund a positive step — but litany of concerns remain
stories.summary: Energy companies would initially hand over up to $50,000, followed by incremental payments across 10 years, with the funds attached to each well regardless of ownership changes.

stories.title: Alouettes fire assistant coach Noel Thorpe
stories.summary: The Montreal Alouettes fired defensive co-ordinator/defensive backs coach Noel Thorpe on Friday.

stories.title: Kaprizov, Hughes lead Wild past Flames 4-1
stories.summary: Kirill Kaprizov and Quinn Hughes extended their point streaks to 13 games on Thursday to lead the Minnesota Wild to a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: Police pursuit of stolen loader up QEII into Airdrie ends with attempted murder charges
stories.summary: Two Mounties and a suspect were injured during a slow-going police pursuit of a construction vehicle stolen from Calgary, which ended when it got stuck in a slough near Airdrie.
